slides.title: Your app says "readiness 42". Now what?
slides.body: A number is one input. It isn't the decision.

slides.title: Letting a score decide for you
slides.body: Low score, cancel everything. High score, force it.

slides.title: Streaks reward sameness
slides.body: A broken streak can feel like failure. It isn't.

slides.title: Ask your own three questions
slides.body: Usable energy? Gentle feels OK? Does the plan still fit?

slides.title: Pick one of three
slides.body: Modified plan, gentle movement or deliberate rest.

slides.title: Just move it down the list
slides.body: Read the number. Then check in with yourself.

slides.title: A check you can run without a screen
slides.body:
